verdict.rationale: Sumsub is a KYC/verification SaaS that exposes its own MCP server so external AI agents can call Sumsub's tools (docs-4, probe-3) — this is the reverse of the story, which asks whether Sumsub itself can consume external MCP servers as a client. There's no indication Sumsub has an agentic core or assistant that ingests third-party MCP tools; this axis is a category mismatch for a verification platform rather than an agent/orchestrator product.
